steps.instruction: Do not change anything. Button 4 must already have the existing AB, Play Once, 20 ms macro assigned. Do not click Save to mouse yet.
Click Save to mouse once with the existing AB macro on Button 4. Do not change any other setting.
Click Save to mouse once more without changing any setting. This repeats the same persistent transaction.
Change only Button 4 from the AB macro to Mouse Function > Back. Do not click Save to mouse during this step.
Click Save to mouse once with Button 4 restored to Back. This restores the original Button 4 onboard assignment.
